ns2:section.sectionText: Course considers questions such as When and why do states enter international treaties? What kind of treaties do they tend to enter? When and why do states comply with treaties? What kind of treaties are they more likely to comply with? Do international treaties work? How do they work? What role do domestic institutions play in treaty negotiation, ratification, and implementation? Not intended for students with freshman standing. Students may receive only three credit hours for PS 300.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Not intended for students with Freshman class standing.
